associations.rationale: Its type is the semisimple-subrepresentation result applied after forming the image; it does not itself construct or identify that image.
Its type states the resulting direct-sum classification of X, a consequence of applying the subrepresentation result rather than the image proof step itself.
Its type constructs the linear map whose image is used in the proof, so it is a prerequisite construction rather than the stated image-and-application claim.
